'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Tobias Buhler DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tobias Buhler]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Tobias Buhler]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]

* '''Username:''' TD
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
